description: Python device-tree readers' outcomes. A case's blob is a named chunk, a chunk cut to length, or the concatenation of [hex, repeat] and [{chunk, start?, end?}, repeat] segments. Each sweep row is one [offset, hex] change of the reservations chunk and its outcome. A refusal is an index into texts. tree_sha256 hashes the tree's binary form: boot CPU and reservation count as big-endian 32-bit words, each reservation as two 64-bit words, the node count, then per node its path and property count and per property its name and value, each path, name and value preceded by its 32-bit length. readers_change holds the outcomes that differ from the named case's readers.
